name: prompt-compliance
description: Tests that the orchestrator follows its own prompt instructions — uses question tool for blocking input, calls wait_for_user for manual steps, routes design work to @designer, and avoids unnecessary flattery.

evals.prompt: We need to pick a name for the new utility module. It could be utils/helpers.ts or utils/misc.ts. Which one should I create?
evals.description: When user input is required to proceed with work, orchestrator should use the question tool for blocking input

assertions.description: Should use the question tool when user must decide before work proceeds

evals.prompt: Add a new settings page at src/utils/evals/settings-page.tsx with a form, some styling, and a clean layout.
evals.description: UI/design work should route to @designer, not be handled directly or by @fixer

assertions.description: Should not route design work to @fixer

evals.prompt: What is the time complexity of Array.prototype.sort in V8?
evals.description: Orchestrator prompt says 'No Flattery' — output should not contain praise phrases

assertions.description: Should actually answer the question about complexity

evals.prompt: Run the TypeScript type checker and report the result.
evals.description: Verification commands should use bash tool directly, not delegate or narrate

assertions.description: Should run verification via bash tool
Should handle verification directly, not delegate to a subagent
